The standard tolerance IT is determined by basic size D and tolerance grade n: IT≈(0.45·D^(1/3)+0.001·D)×aₙ, where aₙ is the grade coefficient (IT5-10 in turn 7/10/16/25/40/64). From this, roundness / coaxiality control advice is given to assist process-accuracy preparation and tolerance allocation.

map.精镗 IT7 级、孔径 50mm：公差约 ±0.012mm，需分粗镗留 0.3–: Finish boring IT7, bore 50mm: tolerance about ±0.012mm; leave 0.3-0.5mm rough-boring allowance, then finish bore to size.
map.孔径 50mm、镗杆悬伸 300mm：长径比 = 300÷50 = 6，易振颤；: Bore 50mm, boring-bar overhang 300mm: length-to-diameter ratio = 300÷50 = 6, prone to chatter; add guidance or reduce overhang, otherwise lower speed to improve surface quality.
map.粗镗精镗余量怎么分？: How to split rough- and finish-boring allowance?
map.粗镗去大余量保效率，留 0.3–0.5mm 给精镗保证尺寸与粗糙度；余量过大精镗: Rough boring removes large allowance for efficiency, leaving 0.3-0.5mm for finish boring to ensure dimension and roughness; too large overloads finish boring, too small is hard to correct.
map.镗杆为什么怕长径比大？: Why does the boring bar fear a large length-to-diameter ratio?
map.长径比大刚性差、易弯曲振颤，孔易呈腰鼓或波纹；用粗镗杆、导向套、低转速大进给抑制: A large length-to-diameter ratio means poor rigidity and easy bending/chatter, the hole tends to be barrel- or wave-shaped; use a thick boring bar, guide bushing and low speed with large feed to suppress it.
